description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): POST /api/links/bulk-transfer-owner must validate every slug exists BEFORE transferring any of them (atomic), plus a destination-owner cumulative capacity check
prompts: Add an optional `owner` field to links (`owner?: string` on the `Link` model, settable via the existing `POST /api/links`' `owner` field), and a `countByOwner(owner)` helper in the link store. Add `POST /api/links/bulk-transfer-owner`: body `{"slugs": [...], "toOwner": "..."}`, moving the given links to a new owner. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY slug in the request refers to an existing link BEFORE transferring any of them - if one doesn't exist, respond 404 and leave every link's owner exactly as it was, not partially transferred; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination owner (only counting links not already owned by them) wouldn't push their link count over the cap of 3, again before transferring anything.
name: add_shortlink_bulk_transfer_owner_atomic
